title: pvVortexCores
body:
## pvVortexCores

Extracts vortex core lines with the parallel-vectors method: lines where velocity is parallel to acceleration (or to jerk with UseHigherOrderMethod). Candidate cells are prefiltered with the Q and delta criteria, and the output polylines carry q-criterion, delta-criterion, lambda_2-criterion, lambda_ci-criterion and vorticity_magnitude point arrays for further filtering. Only 3-D linear cells are processed and the vector field must be a 3-component point array. Use it to locate swirling-flow axes; for vortex regions rather than lines, compute Q or lambda2 with gradient and contour them.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Surface or 2-D meshes and higher-order cells produce no output; supply a linear volume mesh.
- The method is sensitive to noise and finds short spurious segments; threshold the output on the criterion arrays.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `VortexCores`. Identity: `filters/VortexCores`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
